applies_to: TECO-Westinghouse L510 micro inverters with the RS-485 option card, per communication addendum DOCUMENT-TECO-L510-AC001 Ver01 (2015-06).
summary: The L510 is TECO-Westinghouse's micro inverter; with its RS-485 option card it speaks Modbus RTU or ASCII. Run/stop and frequency are written to hex registers 2501H/2502H, status and monitors are read from 2520H-252FH, and each parameter nn-mm has its own register (group in the high byte, number in the low byte). This map covers the command and monitor tables.

addressing.note: Register numbers are hex and sent unchanged: the 06H example writes start register 01 02 (0102H) and the 03H example reads 01 23 (0123H). Parameters map as group in the high byte and number in the low byte, e.g. 00-10 = 000AH, 01-17 = 0111H.

source.title: L510 Communication Addendum Modbus RTU/ASCII
source.pages: pp. 1-1 to 1-4 (connection, frames, exceptions), p. 1-5 (command data), pp. 1-6 to 1-7 (monitor data), examples pp. 1-8 onward, parameter registers from p. 1-13, network p. 1-23

notes: The addendum does not name the drive parameters for node address, baud rate, parity or remote run/frequency source; set those per the L510 instruction manual.
2502H frequency command has no scale in the command table, so it is left unscaled (the read-back 2523H uses 100 = 1 Hz).
2521H is a code table (0-40), mapped as an enum.
Left out: 252BH PID input (sign not stated) and 252CH/252DH AVI/ACI inputs (footnote *1 not explained). 2526H is labelled 'DC voltage command' in the table.
The parameter register rule (group high byte, number low byte, hex) is not expanded into individual registers.

registers.name: Operation signal
registers.description: Run/stop, direction, EFO, reset, jog, comm inputs S1-S5, relay R1.

registers.name: Frequency command
registers.description: Scale not printed in the command table.

integration.summary: Fit the RS-485 option card, set node address and serial settings and select communication as run/frequency source in the L510 parameters, then write 2501H and 2502H and poll 2520H-2527H.
integration.enable: Install the RS-485 option card, then set the node address, communication parameters and run/frequency source at the keypad (parameter numbers are in the L510 manual, not this addendum).
quirks: Registers are hex: 2520H is sent as 25 20.
Write 0 to unused bits and never write reserved registers.
setup: RS-485 via the L510 option card, S+ / S-.
Up to 31 inverters per network; 120 ohm terminators at both ends.
gotchas: Exception codes: 01 function, 02 register number, 03 number, 04 data setting error.
Inverter response time is about 10 ms.

address_note: address = 0-based Modbus wire (PDU) address; documented = as printed in the source.
note: Re-typed from the manufacturer's public documentation (see source) and verified against it. Registers vary by firmware and options; verify against the live device before writing.
